description: TY2025 SS 6654(d)(2), Schedule AI column (a): freelancer with lumpy income — $80,000 SE profit for the year but only $10,000 by March 31. Annualized SE tax: 9,235 net earnings x (0.496 + 0.116) = 5,651.82; period half-SE = /8 = 706.48; AGI 9,293.52 x4 = 37,174.08; minus full std 15,750; QBI 4,284.82 -> TI 17,139.26 -> Table (mid 17,125) $1,817. Line 17 = 7,468.82; x22.5% = 1,680.48. RAP = min(90% x 16,690.64, 20,000) = 15,021.58; 25% = 3,755.40. Installment #1 = min(1,680.48, 3,755.40) = $1,680.48 — less than half the even installment, which is the whole point of the method.
